questions.question: Neeraj Chopra's native village Khandra lies in which district?
questions.rationale: Khandra is in Panipat district. Sonipat, Jhajjar and Rohtak are home districts of other medallists, a classic trap.

questions.question: In which event did Vijender Singh win India's first Olympic boxing medal in 2008?
questions.rationale: He took bronze in the 75 kg middleweight class at Beijing. His Asian Games gold in 2010 was also in middleweight.

questions.question: Sakshi Malik, bronze medallist at Rio 2016, hails from which village?
questions.rationale: Mokhra in Rohtak. Khudan is Bajrang Punia's, Nahri is Ravi Dahiya's and Kaluwas is Vijender Singh's.

questions.question: Which pair of Olympic medals did Manu Bhaker win at Paris 2024?
options: Silver in 25 m pistol and bronze in air rifle
Two bronzes in 10 m air pistol events
Gold and silver in rifle events
One gold in mixed team only
questions.rationale: She won bronze in the women's 10 m air pistol and in the mixed team event with Sarabjot Singh. She was fourth in the 25 m pistol.

questions.question: Which medallist is NOT from Haryana?
questions.rationale: Sushil Kumar was born near Najafgarh, Delhi. The other three are from Sonipat, Sonipat and Jhajjar respectively.

questions.question: Ravi Dahiya of Nahri village won which medal at Tokyo 2020?
questions.rationale: Silver in 57 kg freestyle. Bajrang's bronze was at 65 kg.

questions.question: Sumit Antil's Paralympic javelin gold at Tokyo 2020 came in which classification?
questions.rationale: F64 javelin, with a world record of 68.55 m on 30 August 2021. He defended the title at Paris 2024.

questions.question: Geeta Phogat's 2010 Delhi CWG gold made her the first Indian woman to win Commonwealth gold in:
questions.rationale: She won at 55 kg freestyle wrestling and later became the first Indian woman wrestler to qualify for the Olympics (2012).

questions.question: The Phogat sisters' native village Balali belongs to which district?
questions.rationale: Balali is in Charkhi Dadri district, carved out of Bhiwani. Mahavir Singh Phogat's story inspired the film Dangal.

questions.question: In which year did Yogeshwar Dutt win Olympic bronze, and in which category?
questions.rationale: He took bronze in 60 kg freestyle at London 2012. His Asian Games gold (2014) was at 65 kg.

questions.question: Which statement about the Khel Ratna is correct?
options: It was renamed Major Dhyan Chand Khel Ratna in 2021
Its first recipient was Neeraj Chopra
It is given by the Haryana Government
It was renamed after Rajiv Gandhi in 2021
questions.rationale: The award was Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna until August 2021. It is national, and Viswanathan Anand was the first recipient.

questions.question: Match the Khel Ratna winner with the year: which pair is correct?
questions.rationale: Bajrang got it in 2019. Sakshi won in 2016, Vinesh in 2020 and Dutt in 2012.

questions.question: The maximum Haryana cash award reported for an Olympic silver medal is:
questions.rationale: Reported maximums were Rs 6 crore for gold, 4 crore for silver and 2.5 crore for bronze.

questions.question: Motilal Nehru School of Sports, which later became the base of the state's sports university, is located at:
questions.rationale: The school was founded in 1973 at Rai, Sonipat. The Gurugram location is the Tau Devi Lal Stadium.
